translations.web: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
translations.bsb: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.
translations.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
translations.asv: And one he-goat for a sin-offering unto Jehovah; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.
